correctness.rationale: A compartment of length j survives iff all j ignitions fail, giving j q^j by expectation. I enumerated every sorted positive triple by its first two coordinates, independently checked the 63 rational witnesses with 1,068 strict integer score comparisons after clearing denominators, and confirmed there are 37 feasible triples at 21. The displayed factorizations of A−B and C−B agree with expansion; positive-coefficient derivatives give the requisite monotonicity, and the signs at 759/1000 are strictly negative for S and strictly positive for T. Thus (6,6,9) is excluded everywhere on the open parameter interval, not just near the switch. For every other profile distinct from A and C, exact Sturm counts give no roots of the relevant winner-minus-profile polynomial on each of the two closed subintervals, and its values at both endpoints are positive. These 70 inequalities exhaust all third competitors. The factor 11q^4+11q²−10 is strictly increasing for q>0; its signs at 151/200 and 3797/5000 are opposite by rational arithmetic. Its unique crossing yields the displayed radical, with just A and C tying. The supplied checker does use a Decimal assertion for the root bracket despite the prose describing that decimal as merely illustrative; exact endpoint substitution independently verifies the bracket, so this is not a gap in the theorem.
residual_risks: Only the canonical-stage cutoff through 21 and the stated local window of global optima are proved; no global envelope for larger n is inferred.

value.rationale: This is a sharp counterexample to an adjacent-stage intuition, with all earlier candidate stages certified and with a genuine global switch locally against unequal as well as canonical profiles. The matching objective in the two-compartment problem makes that contrast mathematically natural. The threshold and competitor certificates are useful benchmarks for exact discrete allocation; the result does not make an operational wildfire prediction.
residual_risks: Homogeneous independent-ignition benchmark only; it does not model wind, incomplete breaks, or within-compartment suppression.
